_comment: A PostHog workflow that owns the reminder campaign. Create it as a draft from the PostHog UI or MCP (workflows-create), replace the two placeholders, test-run it against a real reminder_due event, then enable it and set PUSH_SEND_MODE=workflow on the share-preview service. While the service runs in direct mode this workflow is not needed: the three feature flags (reminder-trip-start, reminder-own-arrival, reminder-pickup) are the control.
name: Trip reminders
description: Sends each due trip reminder through the share-preview service, once. Edit this workflow to delay, condition or A/B test a kind; no deploy needed.
